channel.title: Projects on Sam Choi
channel.description: Recent content in Projects on Sam Choi

item.title: BridgePRS
item.author: choishingwan@gmail.com (Sam Choi)
item.description: A powerful trans-ancestry polygenic risk score method that leverages shared genetic effects across ancestries to increase the portability of polygenic risk scores between populations. Second-author contribution, published in Nature Genetics.

item.title: PRSet
item.author: choishingwan@gmail.com (Sam Choi)
item.description: A proof-of-concept gene-set-based polygenic score method that segregates genetic signal into biological pathways and functional categories, rather than treating the genome as a single undifferentiated score.

item.title: EraSOR
item.author: choishingwan@gmail.com (Sam Choi)
item.description: Software that adjusts GWAS summary statistics to correct for inflation of polygenic score-trait association results caused by overlapping samples between discovery and target datasets — using only summary-level data, without requiring raw genotypes.

item.title: PRSice-2
item.author: choishingwan@gmail.com (Sam Choi)
item.description: A widely adopted standalone software implementation of standard polygenic score methodology, built to handle biobank-scale genotyped and imputed data. Cited over 1,900 times as of September 2026.
